messages.subject: Error in validObject(.Object) :
parts:
I run a toy model (see below) and get the following error message. I assume I have done something wrong with the model specification.

...
Simulation complete
....
Finished running the simulation
Computing posterior predictives...
Error in validObject(.Object) : 
  invalid class “blavaan” object: invalid object for slot "Model" in class "blavaan": got class "Model", should be or extend class "lavModel"

Here is my toy model that results in the above error.

####################
library(blavaan)

# Step 1: Specify model
mod.1 <- 'y1 ~ x1
y2 ~ x1
y3 ~ y1 + y2'

x1 <- runif(100)
y1 <- x1 + rnorm(100)/10
y2 <- -.5 * x1 + rnorm(100)/10
y3 <- .5 * y1 + y2 + rnorm(100)/10

datd <- data.frame(x1=x1, y1=y1, y2=y2, y3=y3)

# Step 2b: Estimate model with blavaan
fit <- bsem( mod.1, data=datd )

###########

I hope someone might be able to educate me.
